facts.fact: ZEP-RE states that the DRIVE index-based livestock insurance, run with the Ethiopian government and triggered by a satellite pasture index that crossed the drought threshold after the failed 2025 short rains, paid out ETB 463 million on 24 February 2026.
ZEP-RE states that the DRIVE payout reached 26,929 households.

systems.owner: ZEP-RE with government, World Bank financed

ZEP-RE states that the DRIVE payout reached over 20,000 households.
